title: Apply the cost-chain rule to the fasthash CPU-time claim
prompt: The research-kb server may be unreachable in this environment; if so, record that under 'Sources checked' and use the repository's own files. Every number you report is an unverified assertion unless a pcc claim says otherwise; tag it. Apply AGENTS.md section 3a to the fasthash study in `research/ic_gw_fasthash_20261114/` (arms HASH and COMBO against REF, primary metric relations-phase CPU at identical counted work). Write `$T_OUT/cost-chain-fasthash.md`: the chain, RESTRUCTURE and REPLACE lines, the section 3 class with the reason, what the A/A floor does to the HASH verdict, and why the counted M-eq and the gap to the matched rho do not move. Do not claim a leaderboard change. Do not edit the study. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
acceptance: $T_OUT/cost-chain-fasthash.md has RESTRUCTURE and REPLACE lines and one 'Class:' line
mentions HASH, COMBO, A/A, NOT SUPPORTED and SUPPORTED
states that no leaderboard or benchmarks row moves
check_command: F="$T_OUT/cost-chain-fasthash.md"; grep -q '^RESTRUCTURE' "$F" && grep -q '^REPLACE' "$F" && [ "$(grep -cE '^Class: *(advance|engineering|relabelling|accounting)\b' "$F")" = 1 ] && grep -q 'HASH' "$F" && grep -q 'COMBO' "$F" && grep -q 'A/A' "$F" && grep -q 'NOT SUPPORTED' "$F" && grep -qi 'leaderboard' "$F" && grep -q 'pcc:unverified' "$F" && grep -qi 'sources checked' "$F" && python3 tools/pcc/pcc.py lint-prose "$F" && git diff --quiet "$T_BASE" HEAD -- research/ic_gw_fasthash_20261114
forbidden: editing a file whose SHA-256 a tracked manifest pins (frozen evidence) to make a check pass
disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass
editing the checking tool or its allow-list so that it passes
citing a result as verified without a pcc claim id (use [pcc:unverified])
editing the study or evidence you are checking
inventing a source id, claim id or number
a RESTRUCTURE line that changes the total
notes: Format gate only; class and chain judged by the validator.
